notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE COMPLETE OVERHAUL
notes.content:
Hello, Ember fans!

Well, there are a few obvious changes that have happened, but we are pleased to announce that the entire system has been completely redone and works so well. We are excited to get your feedback on the new gameplay and direction! 

Our change log only covers some of the changes, but there is one MAJOR thing to note. This completely resets the game. You will have to start over from the beginning, but don't worry. There is a lot of new content even at the start. Our team has been working really hard to make sure this game is not only an amazing story with amazing characters, but we have taken to heart all the positive and negative feedback from our players. If you run into any bugs now, at the main menu you will find which beta build you are currently playing, enabling us to eliminate these bugs even quicker! 

We are excited to get your feedback on the title and look forward to delivering, even more, content in the days to come.

Regards,


The Ember Saga Team.

[H1]CHANGES[/H1]

New Intro
New Title
New Icons
New Fonts
Maps Redone
New Quests Added
Enemies Added
Enemy Skills added
Gameplay Changes
All new skill system 
All new stat system
States added

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Greetings Embers,

It has been a LONG time, but we had a lot of changes to make and fix this title.  After a lot of back end work we are finally ready to roll out our first major update.  Most changes are to the game play mechanics and battle balancing, but we have also added a lot of new content as well. The most obvious change is to the quest log and to our new, improved, and expanded over world.  You will start see more regular content coming from here out. We appreciate everyone's patience, and we look forward to bringing a better gaming experience to you.   Below are the changes we have made. You will most likely have to start the game over, which we have tried to avoid, but the changes have been too many for most saved games. 

[H1]ITEMS[/H1]
[list]
[*]Health Potion(Item)
Recovery now at 20%
Increased drop rate in Gazerbat and Ectophage.
[*]Drought of Life(Item)
Recovery now 20% +10 HP.
[*](New Item) Bandit’s Delight
High drop rate from bandits type enemies
25% recovery
10% chance to gain state dizzy
[*](New Item) Honey 
5% Hp and Mp recovery
New  Dizzy (State)
80% defense, -5% hit rate, 2-7 turns or 50 steps
Add State Dizzy to Wine
[/list]
[H1]CLASS CHANGES[/H1]
[list]
[*]Class Stat changes
[*]+1 max hp per level
[*]+0.5-1 defense on ranged classes
[*]-0.5 defense on melee classes
[*]-0.5 agility to all
[/list]
[H1]GAME MECHANIC CHANGES[/H1]
[list]
[*] Retreating from Battle
Retreat check 20% easier
+15 to party on check 
Fixed early levels inability to escape.
[*]Changed defense and magic defense calculation
Armor is no longer a direct subtraction from attack value but is built as % of damage blocked. So both attack and defense now have a variation of number value. Giving better numbers. Example 2,2,2,2 was changed to 1,3,4,2.
[/list]
[H1]ENEMY CHANGES[/H1]
[list]
[*]Hornet
Max hp down 15 to 12
Defense up 4 to 5
Honey added to drop
[*]Cave & Swamp Ectophage
Defense down 10 to 8
Max hp up 15 to 22
[*]All bandits
Defense down by 1
[/list]
[H1]WORLD CHANGES[/H1]
[list][*]New game world map.
[*][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25720705/1e44c7b25c3bb7a512ab18332385c84cfcad5c3a.png[/img]
[/list]
[H1]FUTURE UPDATE OUTLOOK[/H1]
[list]
[*]New Areas
Wellenton 
[*]Gameplay mechanics
Quest rewards
Skill re-balancing
XP re-balancing
[/list]

notes.title: Latest News
notes.content:
After thousands of hours of gameplay in A New Fire, we realized that the current direction for the game mechanics (not the story) needed a major overhaul. In response to this need, we have brought on a seasoned game designer who will be taking over Donavan's role on the development of the project. Donavan will still be involved in the community aspect of the team. The classes will be changed as well making the game more consistent.  We have hired Mikolaj Marcisz to fix our gameplay balance and have brought on Hans Yianaridis to assist in side quest content and stories.  

You are able to access the beta branch on your own by right clicking on The Ember Series: A New Fire and going to properties. Under the BETA branch, you can select testing - In House Testing. Just be aware that this will break your existing saves for certain.  You will be able to experience some of the new quest and the new overworld map experience, however, the gameplay is just not up to the task. The game is frankly too hard and doesn't scale well in its current state. 

I know the wait has been WAY too long since our last update, but at least by accessing the beta branch, you can experience what we are working on it.  We are online and actively working on the project. Please continue to connect with us and give your feedback.  It is because of you all and your playing experience that has helped us get to his direction now.  The wait will be long, but we promise it will be worth it. We would rather there be a little bit longer delay and deliver an excellent build for you all than to keep throwing band-aids on the problem.  The gameplay required extensive surgery, not band-aids to fix the problem, so we are in surgery right now.  

We were asked by multiple fans of the game if the feature where there are separate quest line for each class would still be available. This is for us, one of the major draws to the game, so yes, we will be keeping this feature still.

We have included some pictures to give you all a glimpse of the gameplay mechanics and some new content as well.  I know this has been frustrating for you folks, but trust us, it has been equally so for us as well. We are committed as every to bringing you an amazing project!

Pictures of changes  
[url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B2XV0UxvwXEfTFltcjExbG1ZYjg]Gameplay Balance Pic[/url]
[url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B2XV0UxvwXEfMDd6SVRxQk94V0U]New Trylista Map[/url]
[url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B2XV0UxvwXEfYXhVTGp6MHpiRXc]City of Trylista Map[/url]
[url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B2XV0UxvwXEfR25kcTB4SnZfLVk]Beastiary[/url]

notes.title: Patch #1.2
notes.content:
Hello Embers,

We have been hard at work balancing out the game for you and continuing to work on the world of Mörja. I can tell you that we have more coming within the next two weeks including a new and improved overworld map (hint: it is a HUGE) and actual quest content.  We are working on delivering a quest log, in-game map, a resizing screen option, side quest content, and a new town to explore. Thanks again for all of your support, input, and help!  You all rock!

Thanks

The Forthright Team. 


Changelog v 1.2
[list]
[*]Added Stat Distribution to the game.  Players can now adjust their stats separately of the skills.
[*]Fixed magic skills to have base damage that is guaranteed.
[*]Changed amount of SP given on level up.
[*]Adjust EXP values to fit the values that we are looking for.
[*]Adjust Crit chance and evals for dice rolls to allow for less critical hits.
[*]Put down framework for new quest log and crafting/harvesting system.
[*]Mana and Health Potions now heal for a % of your existing HP or MP. 
[*]Changed the HP given on Draught of Life to a percentage.
[*]Fixed the encounter rate so that you can ACTUALLY explore the game. 
[*]Add more people to Upea Ranta and Lowland Creek.
[*]Fixed some minor spelling errors. 
[*]Added trading cards, backgrounds, and emoticons.
[/list]

notes.title: A New Fire Lights Up Early Access
notes.content:
After thousands of man hours, Forthright Entertainment is proud to officially launch The Ember Series: A New Fire on Steam Early Access. We are excited for you to begin your journey through the magical lands of Mörja, a universe filled with unique characters, creatures, and mythios. Join a group of friends as they grow through trials and tribulations in a whole new world. Don't you dare close your eyes. Yep, we just went there. And P.S., you'll find a lot more Easter eggs in our game referencing movies, pop culture, and other games. 

As game players ourselves, we have experienced the pitfalls of many Early Access projects from a player's perspective. We understand the risks you are taking to trust in us to deliver a great gaming experience. We don't take that lightly. 

Since the demo launched on July 20, 2016, we have added an entirely new and extensive skill and class system, complete with passive traits and skills specifically tailored to each class. We also completely revamped the combat system to conform to the D20 rule set. And we've laid the foundations to add an in-depth crafting/harvesting system, as well as a mini map option for those that like to play with one, both of which will be released in a future update.

Our promise to you is that you will be included, valued, and that your feedback WILL help shape this game. We may not be able to implement everything everyone would like to see in the game. However, we look forward to seeing this game evolve with your input and are excited to deliver to you a product worthy of being enjoyed by gamers everywhere. 

-The Forthright Team

Ryan, Donavan, Ailynn, Michelle, Natalea, G'dalyah, Josh, Mario, Geovanie, Jed, George, and Ken

notes.title: Early Access coming soon!
notes.content: We are excited to announce that Early Access is coming very soon.  We hope to start Early Access by 8/19.  That's this Friday for those of you who are not near a calendar. notes.title: REPUBLIC OF TRYLISTA
notes.content:
[h1]HISTORY[/h1]
 The Republic of Trylista is the only nation in Mörja that elects its leaders. Trylista’s economy is made up from farming, timber, and mining. The Republic earned its freedom 98 years ago after a four-year battle with the Kingdom of Evarst.  King Eladias II of Evarst was killed during the battle of the Bridge of Evarst, allowing his son, Prince Riganold, to rise to the throne. Prince Riganold was a righteous and wise young man and called for a meeting with General Prapaious of Trylista.  Riganold and Prapaious both felt that the conflict was costing too many lives and agreed to a peace treaty that many in the Kingdom of Evarst believed gave up too much land to Trylista.
